description:
Goal

Make direct callable transport selection a monotone refinement of the producer-to-use relation already carried by semantic and runtime-demand facts. Joined demand must not create cartesian obligations, and physical layout must never decide which producer is semantically eligible.

Output contract

For a known callable target, a producer shape is eligible only when its carried CallableDirectEdge matches the carried CallableTarget by semantic surface and activation identity. For targetless direct demand, eligibility follows per-edge semantic non-disjointness only where upstream flow explicitly establishes direct invocation. Explicit opaque, escaped, or otherwise first-class flow uses first_class_edges and boundary facts instead of pretending to be a failed direct match. Transport selects semantic alternatives first, then refines the selected shapes to one exact shape or their existing common boxed callable ABI.

Current first loss

CallableDemand already relates surface to activation. Each producer-owned CallableFlowFact already relates surface to resolution, and transport preserves that as CallableDirectEdge with semantic surface_inputs, resolution, and physical argument shapes. callable_input_shapes_for_demand discards target and resolution identity, renders the joined resolved surfaces physically, and requires each producer shape to cover every surface. In two valid Enum.drop_while calls, joined direct and recursive first-class surfaces therefore reject both direct producers and fall through to SourceShape::Unknown.

Spike proof

The current-HEAD spike at 2e4f39973 compares three production-path selectors:

- Universal physical coverage rejects valid paired drop_while producers.
- Existential physical coverage admits valid producers but also admits an untargeted producer with the same semantic and physical surface.
- Target-correlated semantic edge selection admits both valid drop_while producers and only the demanded producer in the same-layout adversary.

The spike ran six fixtures through interpreter, JIT, and AOT under all three variants, 54 successful warning-free combinations. The existing relation is sufficient; no provenance, clause, or parallel identity model is needed.

Strategy

1. Pin the output contract with a production-path transport test containing two callable shapes with identical semantic and physical surfaces but distinct carried resolutions; demand one target and require only its producer.
2. Replace the universal physical selector at the first loss with a selector over existing CallableTarget and CallableDirectEdge relations. Consume carried surface and resolution identity directly; do not compare activation_inputs with key inputs or reconstruct identity from types, captures, shapes, ordering, or debug text.
3. Keep targetless direct demand and explicit first-class demand as separate modeled paths. A first-class value with no direct target is valid and must refine through first_class_edges.
4. After semantic selection, retain one selected exact producer shape or use the existing common boxed callable ABI for multiple selected producers. Do not genericize before selection.
5. Make zero matches for a settled known-target demand an internal invariant failure carrying the demand and available edges. Do not turn it into SourceShape::Unknown or a language-level function_clause.
6. Delete callable_input_shape_satisfies_demand, eager physical surface construction used only for selection, and any superseded generic fallback path. Remove all spike switches, instrumentation, fixtures, and synthetic mechanics before promotion.

Signal

- Paired and single drop_while probes pass interp, run, and build.
- The same-layout/same-surface adversary selects exactly the demanded producer.
- Named-reference and same-surface captured-closure controls remain exact where authority permits.
- Explicit uncalled first-class flow remains boxed without a fabricated direct target.
- A settled known target with no correlated producer edge fails loudly at the transport invariant.
- No selection decision reads physical ShapeId equality.

Scope boundaries

The remaining projected-source Unknown has a distinct upstream source-flow cause and is tracked by fz-k22.30; this ticket must not compensate for it. The uncalled first-class interpreter/native value discrepancy is tracked by fz-k22.31; this ticket preserves its first-class authority but does not choose display semantics.

Acceptance

The focused relation tests and the six spike behaviors pass across interp, run, and build; cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass. The diff adds no provenance or alternate clause model, removes the universal physical selection mechanics, performs physical ABI refinement only after semantic selection, and contains no spike scaffolding.
title: Select callable transport producers through carried target-edge relations
